notes: 2023 season, collected 2026-08-17 via WebFetch. adpY: FantasyFootballCalculator PPR 12-team 2023 preseason ADP (fantasyfootballcalculator.com/adp/ppr/12-team/all/2023); 'Overall' pick numbers verbatim; full 202-row table transcribed, 25 DEF/PK rows dropped -> 177 QB/RB/WR/TE. Team = FFC's stored team, which for a few players reflects mid-2023 trades (e.g. Cam Akers MIN). projY: FFToday 2023 preseason season-total projections (fftoday.com/rankings/playerproj.php?Season=2023&PosID=10/20/30/40, default LeagueID, top 40 QB / 85 RB / 100 WR / 40 TE). VERIFIED the page's FPts is FFToday HALF-PPR, not standard: recomputed top-5 RB/WR/TE stat lines exactly (e.g. McCaffrey 246/1107/7 rush + 79rec/672/5 = 249.9 std + 39.5 = 289.4). Therefore proj = page FPts + 0.5*Rec (Rec column captured per player) to convert half-PPR -> full PPR for RB/WR/TE; QB proj = FPts unchanged (no receptions; FFToday QB scoring verified as 0.04/pass yd, 4/pass TD, 0.1/rush yd, 6/rush TD, no INT deduction). projY is listed in FFToday's half-PPR rank order, so proj values are not strictly monotonic after conversion. actualY: FantasyPros per-position 2023 season stats pages (fantasypros.com/nfl/stats/{qb,rb,wr,te}.php?year=2023&scoring=PPR), FPTS and G columns verbatim, top 45 QB / 80 RB / 100 WR / 40 TE; QB FPTS is FantasyPros standard QB scoring (4pt pass TD, 0.04/yd), identical to PPR for QBs. gamesPrev: same FantasyPros stats pages with year=2022 (PPR rank order), G column; top 90 RB/WR/TE, QB table ends at 88 rows so all 88 included. Names are verbatim per source and sources differ on suffixes: FantasyPros uses 'Patrick Mahomes II', 'Aaron Jones Sr.', 'Kenneth Walker III', 'Travis Etienne Jr.', 'James Cook III', 'Chris Godwin Jr.', 'Deebo Samuel Sr.', 'Kyle Pitts Sr.'; FFC/FFToday mostly omit or vary suffixes (FFToday: 'Travis Etienne', 'Aaron Jones', 'Kenneth Walker', 'Anthony Richardson'); FantasyPros 2022 page uses retroactive renames 'Nyheim Miller-Hines' and 'Bam Knight' (=Zonovan Knight). Normalize names (strip suffixes/punctuation) before joining across sections. All numbers transcribed from source pages; none estimated or invented.
